text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for Enterococcus faecalis (>100,000 CFU/mL). Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. Glucosuria is present without ketonuria, which may warrant further evaluation for glycemic status. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
